units: hbar=1, square side=1; energy unit set by chosen neutral omega; charges dimensionless assigned inputs. I has inverse-energy units. A has inverse-length per unit charge and B inverse-area per unit charge.
material_coordinates: Four actual body positions r_v=(+/-.5,+/-.5,0), with physical lab positions x_v=R r_v. R is a dynamical SO(3) rigid material orientation, not an internal spin rotation relabeling. Three hard-core separately conserved charged flavor positions move on body bonds. Four neutral axial singlet+triplet cells are located on body bonds and rotate with the actual material.
body_law: Hbody=omega sum_b Ntrip_b + Coulomb_body - t sum_allowed_hops identity - g sum_occupied_bonds P_b.(S_v-S_w) - u sum_occupied_bonds Q_bz. spin_orbit=0. Q_ba=|a><0|+|0><a| is axial/time-even, P_ba=i|a><0|-i|0><a| axial/time-odd; triplet L_ba=-i epsilon_abc|b><c|. No primitive Pauli Zeeman moment or imposed Heisenberg term.
physical_lab_law: Hlab(0)=L_material_lab^2/(2I)+U(R) Hbody U(R)^dagger; for unequal moments the kinetic is rigid-body Laplace-Beltrami sum_a L_body_a^2/(2I_a). U rotates ALL primitive spins and ALL neutral triplets into the lab. Axial pre-twist and physical positions rotate with R. This is a new coupled geometry law, not the predecessor's internal SU2.
body_gauge: psi_lab(R)=U(R) chi(R). Right generators N_a act on orientation and have [N_a,N_b]=-i epsilon_abc N_c; T_a=S_constituents_a+sum_b L_ba have positive algebra. Mechanical body derivative D_a=N_a-T_a. H(0)=Hbody+sum_a D_a^2/(2I_a). Lab physical J is the LEFT orientation generator acting on chi; in lab variables it is L_material_lab+S_constituents_lab+sum_b L_carrier_lab. Lab internal vector is R T; mechanical lab vector is J-R T. This decomposition, not internal T^2, determines physical spin.
basis_and_selection: Normalized orientation functions sqrt(2j+1) D^{j*}_{MK}; N_a=J_a^T acts on all K. The odd number of primitive spinors makes chi antiperiodic under 2pi, cancelling U's sign, so the physical SO3 wavefunction is single-valued while physical total representations are half-integer. Conserved M=.5 contains EVERY half-integer j, not just j=.5. The entire (2j+1) K x 49152 body space is retained for each explicitly compared j=.5,1.5,2.5. Every M in a full multiplet is symmetry-equivalent and is restored by the exact representation. No fixed physical jhalf input.
all_higher_j_comparison: For u=0, Hbody commutes with T^2. At a fixed j,T, D^2 has minimum |j-T|(|j-T|+1). For every j>=1.5, T=.5 costs at least 2 Bmin, while T>=1.5 costs at least the isotropic body high-T spectral minimum. Axial perturbation has operator norm <=2|u| because every three-of-four hard-core position has exactly two occupied edges. Thus E_j>=min(Ebody_iso_low+2 Bmin,Ebody_iso_T>=1.5)-2|u|, Bmin=min_a 1/(2I_a). The spectrum inputs are numerical Lanczos minima, not interval-certified lower bounds; distinguish this conditional comparison from direct j calculations.
minimal_coupling_before_projection: Start with Lrot=sum_a I_a Omega_a^2/2 + Omega.a(R,x;A), where a_a=sum_i q_i[r_i x R^-1 A(Rr_i)]_a. Quantize Hrot(A)=sum_a (D_a-a_a)^2/(2I_a) with covariant symmetric ordering BEFORE angular projection; full Peierls hopping uses the same lab A integrated along rotated physical body edges.
uniform_A_current: For lab uniform A_i, F_i,a=epsilon_abc d_body_b R_ic with d_body=sum_i q_i r_i. Jmechanical_i=sum_a {D_a,F_i,a}/(2I_a). JPeierls_i=R_ia JbodyPeierls_a, Jtotal=Jmechanical+JPeierls. The physical check is J_jp,j=i(H_jp d_lab_jp,j-d_lab_jp,j H_j) with actual charge dipole d_lab=R d_body. Hopping alone is a deliberately wrong source and must fail this continuum charge-motion identity.
uniform_B_moment: For A(x)=B x x/2, a_a=C_ab (R^-1 B)_b, C_ab=.5 sum_i q_i(r_i^2 delta_ab-r_ia r_ib). F_B_i,a=R_ib C_ba. mu_mechanical_i=sum_a {D_a,F_B_i,a}/(2I_a). mu_Peierls_i=R_iz mu_body_z for the planar body. mu_total=-dH/dB_i. This is actual charged mechanical motion plus actual intracell charge hops, not T or neutral L renamed as magnetization.
contact: d2Hrot/dB_i2=sum_a F_B_i,a^2/I_a plus rotated literal hopping contact. Project this WHOLE quadratic product; intermediate j-1,j,j+1 and all M/K/internal states are retained. Squaring an already projected jhalf F would lose the jthreehalf contact contribution and is not used.
rotation_covariance: R matrix elements are exact Haar CG products sqrt((2j+1)/(2jp+1)) CG(j M,1 mu|jp Mp) CG(j K,1 nu|jp Kp), with fixed Cartesian/spherical transformation. Full R*N=J and Cartesian [J_i,V_j]=i epsilon_ijk V_k are actual numerical geometry checks. H_j is independent of M but includes nontrivial mechanical/internal angular exchange. Vector magnetic/current source can connect jhalf to jhalf and jthreehalf; all their internal high virtuals remain in response.
magnetic_receiver: Supplied uniform external B, not a derived propagating photon or Maxwell field energy. Actual finite receiver diagonalizes H0-B.mu+B^2 contact/2 in complete jhalf and jthreehalf Mhalf body spaces. Diagonal projected contact is included, cross-j contact omitted; ground energy is correct through quadratic small-B response, not an exact arbitrary-B law. Full same-H source resolvent uses bounded full-state Lanczos rather than projecting to low eigenstates.
binding_reference: Predecessor fixed-square dressed pair+single binding is ANTECEDENT ONLY. No new freebody breakup energy is claimed because the fragment law must include its own same-convention physical rotor/material scaffold. New neutral loading energy and excitation are recomputed jointly but do not by themselves prove self-binding without rigidity.
